templates.source: ABUS TVIP62000 User Manual (ManualsLib manual/1100998, p.17 and p.55): documents rtsp://{user}:{pass}@{ip}:554/h264 as the H.264 stream URL. Independently confirmed in the ABUS TVIP11502 User Manual (ManualsLib manual/1134406, p.15) and ABUS TVIP21502 User Manual (ManualsLib manual/1085508, p.16), both documenting the same /h264 path for H.264 streams on the native ABUS TVIP camera platform. — https://www.manualslib.com/manual/1100998/Abus-Tvip62000.html?page=55

ABUS TVIP62000 User Manual (ManualsLib manual/1100998, p.17 and p.55): documents rtsp://{user}:{pass}@{ip}:554/mpeg4 as the MPEG-4 stream URL. Same path confirmed in TVIP11502 (p.15) and TVIP21502 (p.16). /mjpeg is a third variant (MJPEG). The TVIP platform supports all three codecs via distinct paths; /mpeg4 is the documented lower-bitrate second stream option. — https://www.manualslib.com/manual/1100998/Abus-Tvip62000.html?page=55

No official ABUS user manual or technical document reviewed confirms this path for any ABUS-branded camera line. All community references citing this path for ABUS (iSpy, smartvision.dev, etc.) are community-sourced and explicitly disclaim accuracy. Cross-brand contamination from Hikvision OEM ecosystem. D-Link / OEM-style SDP credential-in-URL path. Official ABUS TVIP21502 manual (ManualsLib p.16) documents this exact format for the TVIP21502 (which uses a different platform from the main TVIP62000/TVIP11502 series): rtsp://192.168.1.14:554/video.h264 is that model's documented path — not the credential-in-URL variant. The credential-in-URL form matches D-Link / Foscam OEM firmware, not the ABUS platform. Excluded.

Partially plausible: the ABUS TVIP41550 manual (ManualsLib manual/1016305, p.28 and p.72) documents a configurable RTSP access name scheme (rtsp://<ip>:<port>/<accessname>), with /live.sdp cited as one example value. However, the access name is user-configurable — it is not a fixed path. Cannot be published as a reliable template. Excluded as a canonical path, but noted here for reference.

notes: ABUS (ABUS Security-Center GmbH, Affing, Germany) runs its own native IP camera firmware platform across the TVIP and IPCB/IPCS series. Official ABUS user manuals (TVIP62000, TVIP11502, TVIP21502 — confirmed via ManualsLib) document three RTSP path variants on the native platform: /h264 (H.264), /mpeg4 (MPEG-4), /mjpeg (MJPEG), all on port 554 with credentials in the URL (rtsp://{user}:{pass}@{ip}:554/<codec>). The older TVIP41550 uses a configurable access-name scheme rather than fixed paths. The heavily-represented Hikvision /Streaming/Channels/101 path appears only in community aggregators for ABUS and is not confirmed by any official ABUS documentation reviewed — it is treated as cross-brand lead contamination. ABUS may sell some Hikvision-OEM models (community sources mention a 'CF3' model), but no official ABUS document was found confirming Hikvision RTSP paths for ABUS-branded hardware. The /mjpeg path is a valid third stream option not listed as a separate template here since the spec focuses on main/sub; integrators should use /mjpeg for MJPEG access.
